test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Tom said that he had a strange experience the day before.

options.text: Tom said, “I must have a strange experience the day before.”
Tom exclaimed, "What a strange experience it was!"
Tom said, “I will have a strange experience the day before.”
Tom said, “I had a strange experience yesterday.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Tom said that he had a strange experience the day before.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"he had a strange experience" becomes "I had a strange experience"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" to match the direct speech.
 
• Maintains the past tense of the verb "had".
 
 
 
• **"the day before" becomes "yesterday"**
 
 
• Time expression "the day before" is changed to "yesterday" in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period ".".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“I had a strange experience yesterday,” Tom said."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Tom said, “I must have a strange experience the day before.”" 

 
 
• Incorrect modal verb "must" changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Tom exclaimed, "What a strange experience it was!"" 
 
 
• Changes the reporting verb to "exclaimed" and alters the structure and meaning of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Tom said, “I will have a strange experience the day before.”" 
 
 
• Incorrect future tense "will have" changes the meaning of the sentence.
